mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q WHERE q.category_id = c.id AND q.status = 1) AS questionCount FROM category c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.parent_id = 0 ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT id, parent_id, name, icon, sort, status, created_at, updated_at FROM category WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT category_id AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS questionCount FROM question WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY category_id

SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q WHERE q.category_id = c.id AND q.status = 1) AS questionCount FROM category c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM category s WHERE s.parent_id = c.id AND s.status = 1) ORDER BY c.parent_id ASC, c.sort ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT 50
